regime_context: China A-shares show a narrow, one-narrative tape led by Coal, with Banks as the only crowded challenger. The absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false) and the backtest verdict flags mean-reverting behavior, so all leans must be humble and conditional rather than treated as validated trend calls.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Banks' crowding flag (1.83) resolves by durability holding (0.82) or starts to compress breadth from 0.833. If Banks' breadth drops below 0.6 while Coal's breadth rises above 0.5, the confirmed handoff from Coal to Banks would be retired; if Banks remain crowded but breadth stays high, treat Banks as a persistent reflexive leader to avoid rather than challenge.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the top-ranked eligible theme (rank 1, score 0.8) with a non-crowded crowding_z of 0.39 and acceptable durability_bar of 0.49. It is the dominant one-narrative leader, but the momentum rank is a focus lens, not alpha, and the trend gate did not help on this mean-reverting market. Lean is a modest directional preference supported by leadership and non-crowding, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: The mean-reverting tape means leadership can whipsaw quickly; r10 of -0.0327 shows Coal itself has been weak over the last 10 days despite top rank, and narrow breadth suggests the narrative is not broadly supported.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS prints a 5% drawdown from its 20-day high before the check-by date

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are eligible and rank 2 with high durability (0.82) and strong breadth (0.833), but are crowded (crowding_z 1.83). Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution only — never a fade — so the lean is avoid rather than underweight. The high crowding suggests the trade may be reflexively extended.
theses.dissent: Banks have the strongest structural trend (durability 0.82, breadth 0.833) and crowding in a reflexive market can persist longer than expected; avoiding may forgo continued leadership.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS outperforms CSI 300 by 3% without a crowding unwind before the check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Innovative Pharma ranks 11 with a negative score (-0.135) and is crowded (crowding_z 1.17) despite being eligible. Low momentum rank combined with crowding suggests it is a lagging theme with reflexivity risk. The lean is a directional underweight, not a short.
theses.dissent: Mixed hurst tag and eligible status could mean Pharma is forming a base; mean-reverting markets sometimes reward laggards when crowded leaders stall.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ outperforms CSI 300 by 4% over a 10-day window before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
